title: Create a Log Pile Habitat
description: Ask a grown-up to help you stack some old logs in a quiet corner of your garden. Log piles provide shelter and breeding grounds for various insects, amphibians, and small mammals. They also help improve soil health as they decompose.

title: Build a Bird Feeder
description: Using a pine cone, peanut butter, and birdseed, you can create a simple bird feeder. Spread peanut butter over the pine cone and roll it in birdseed. Hang it from a tree branch using a piece of string. Watch as different bird species visit your feeder!

title: Make a Bug Hotel
description: Make a bug hotel out of a box of bugs, cardboard, and string. Hang it from a tree branch using a piece of string. Watch as different insect species visit your bug hotel!

title: Set Up a Water Dish
description: Put out a shallow dish of fresh water for birds and hedgehogs to drink. Remember to change the water every day so it stays clean!
